description:
kith-store/src/contact.rs:stamp_contact_counters() (line 514) branches on three cases: created_at == 0 (fresh insert), created_at < 0 (pre-V8 sentinel set by V17 migration), and otherwise (existing row). The magic value -1 appears in migration SQL at V17 (SCHEMA_V17) and is silently implied in the code's < 0 check.

The -1 sentinel has non-obvious origin: V13 backfilled created_at_counter = 0 for old rows, V17 then changed those 0 values to -1 to distinguish 'existed at counter=0' from 'just inserted and counter happens to be 0'. This multi-migration interaction is only explained in code comments spread across lib.rs (V13, V17 migration strings) and contact.rs.

Suggested improvement: define a named constant (const PRE_V8_SENTINEL: i64 = -1) in contact.rs with a comment pointing to the V13/V17 migration pair. This makes the branch condition self-documenting without requiring the reader to reconstruct the migration history.
title: stamp_contact_counters encodes sentinel semantics in magic integer constants
